paragraphs.text:
Charlie levers a bullet into the chamber of her rifle. With cold 
eyes, she backs away. “Go then, Professor, if you must. Go to them 
and die.” It seems wise not to follow her. It is clear that you will 
have to manage without your canoe and your guide.
But you cannot think of that now. Bernard needs your help.
Record the keyword BAREFOOT. Go to 152.
